model_output.score_comment_short: The support tasks are clear, but most bullets lack detail about the work.
model_output.score_comment_long: The internship connects help desk tickets, classroom laptops, and Active Directory. Most bullets stop before explaining the problems handled or setup steps. Adding a few concrete examples would make the work easier to assess.
model_output.score_plain: A reviewer can identify your entry-level IT direction, but may have difficulty comparing your practical experience with a particular job. More detail in the internship bullets would give them a better basis for that comparison.
model_output.first_impression: Your path into IT runs from helping retail customers with devices to supporting teachers and staff. The internship is relevant to desktop support, but its short bullets leave much of the day-to-day work unexplained.
model_output.biggest_gap_example: "Answered help desk tickets from teachers and staff" does not say what issues you handled or how you resolved them, leaving your troubleshooting experience unclear.
model_output.summary: Setting up devices in retail and imaging classroom laptops gives your move into IT a practical through-line. The school internship adds account work in Active Directory, which is useful to keep visible alongside the laptop work. The experience presented fits an entry-level support role. A reviewer may still wonder what you could troubleshoot independently because the ticket bullet names the users but not their problems.
strengths: The classroom laptop bullet names both imaging and setup, showing more than general familiarity with computers.
Resetting passwords and accounts in Active Directory identifies a specific support task and system.
The retail role includes helping customers choose laptops, printers, and accessories, which shows experience discussing device needs with customers.
gaps: The internship does not explain what steps you took when preparing laptops, so the depth of your setup work is unclear.
Microsoft 365 administration and basic networking appear in Skills without examples elsewhere, leaving their practical use difficult to place.
The summary names both desktop support and a junior systems role without distinguishing your preparation for each, which may make targeting less direct.
